name: The DELPHI Detector at LEP
notes: Preprint date (src:lep-inspire-detector-papers) is 1990-09; the journal issue is 1991. Both report numbers CERN-PPE-90-128 and CERN-EF-90-5 are listed by INSPIRE; only the first is carried in reference.report_number.

summary.plain: The DELPHI collaboration's own full technical description of the finished detector.
summary.technical: Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 303 (1991) 233-276 (reports CERN-PPE-90-128, CERN-EF-90-5); the standard DELPHI detector-paper reference, describing the RICH particle-identification system, silicon vertex detector, tracking, calorimetry and muon systems.
